description:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. 
 
 7-Eleven is looking for a Platform Engineer to join the Enterprise Data Platform Engineering / DevOps team.
 At 7-Eleven, Enterprise Data brings together large-scale data from across the company. The Enterprise Data Platform team supports the tools, cloud services, and automation that help Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists build and run their work. This role helps keep those platforms reliable, secure, and easier for teams to use.
 Responsibilities 
 As part of the Platform Engineering team, you will help support cloud infrastructure and platform tools used by the Enterprise Data team. This includes helping deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain services in Azure, supporting automation, and improving the developer experience for data teams.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Support cloud infrastructure for Enterprise Data, mostly in Azure. 
 Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain data platform services such as Databricks, Kafka, and related tools. 
 Use infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, to support repeatable and well-controlled changes. 
 Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. 
 Write and maintain scripts in Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate routine platform work. 
 Use approved AI tools to help write code, review code, test changes, troubleshoot issues, and improve documentation. 
 Use AI-assisted tools responsibly by checking results, protecting company data, and following security and privacy rules. 
 Support monitoring, logging, alerting, and basic incident response for platform services. 
 Maintain clear documentation for platform services, common support steps, and team processes. 
 Work with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists to help them use platform tools correctly. 
 Participate in Agile team activities such as standups, planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. 
 Work with partner teams such as Cloud Engineering, Information Security, and application teams when needed. 
  
 Qualifications 
 To ensure success in this role, we are looking for candidates that meet these basic and recommended qualifications.
 Basic Qualifications:
 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role, with hands-on experience supporting cloud infrastructure in Azure or AWS. 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or relevant work experience) 
 Working experience with at least one infrastructure-as-code tool, such as Terraform, CDK, Pulumi, ARM, or CloudFormation. 
 Working experience with at least one CI/CD tool, such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. 
 Working experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, Bash, or JavaScript. 
 Working knowledge of Linux server administration and the Linux command line. 
 Working knowledge of cloud networking basics, including VNets, load balancing, NAT, DNS, and firewalls. 
 Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability practices. 
 Working knowledge of application security basics, including TLS, OAuth, firewalls, PKI, and API security. 
 Experience with containers and container orchestration tools, such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 Experience using approved AI-assisted tools for coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or platform support. 
 Ability to check AI-generated output for accuracy, quality, security, and fit before using it. 
 Preferred / Nice-to-have Qualifications:
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 
 Experience supporting Agile team activities and working with technical and business partners. 
 Experience in Full-Stack software engineering – building web or mobile applications, for public or internal customers 
 Experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or AI/ML 
 Experience working with or administering Data Analytics Platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift + Glue, Airflow, Kafka, Pinot. 
 Experience designing and provisioning networks in hybrid cloud environments, or cross- cloud environments. 
 Certifications in either Azure or AWS Cloud technologies
